First Line

First line using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

first_line(text)

Example input

{
  "text": "\n102.\nExplanation"
}

Example output

"102."

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py first_line < examples/first-line.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
